title: Check yourself: Prompt or code: where a guarantee lives

questions.stem: A gate in a support agent's dispatcher refuses a refund because no identity has been verified. What should the dispatcher send back to the model?

options.text: A flagged failure result that names the missing step
options.says: Every call needs an answer, and an error that names the missing step lets the model do it and try again.
Ruled out because the API requires a result: "Tool result blocks must immediately follow their corresponding tool use blocks in the message history."

options.text: A generic error that says only that the call failed
options.says: Ruled out because the documentation's advice is to "include what went wrong and what Claude should try next".

options.text: The refund's result after running the verification itself
options.says: Ruled out because the model must obtain the code from the customer: "the gate refuses and says what is missing".

questions.stem: On a model that supports forced tool use, a team forces the verification tool through tool_choice on the first request, believing the order of steps is now guaranteed. Which gap remains?

options.text: Later tools can stay blocked until verification returns a result
options.says: Ruled out because keeping later tools blocked until verification returns is what a gate does, not what a forced choice does: "An order between steps is a property of the program that runs them."

options.text: Text written before the call changes the order in which the tools run
options.says: Ruled out because the model writes no text before a forced call: "the API prefills the assistant message to force a tool to be used".

options.text: Later turns are unconstrained, so a refund can still follow a failed check
options.says: A forced choice applies to the request that sets it, and nothing carries it to later calls.

options.text: The forced choice discards the cached tool definitions and system prompt
options.says: Ruled out because the page says that a changed `tool_choice` invalidates "cached message blocks", "while tool definitions and system prompts remain cached".
